summary: US cash markets were closed on 26 Nov for Thanksgiving after a volatile Wednesday: the Nasdaq 100 briefly fell 20% below its October record before recovering to close down 0.6%, with the S&P 500 down 0.3%, against a hot inflation print and tariff concerns. Nvidia fell 3.9% after S&P Global warned of a possible credit downgrade over governance. European tech fell on AI and rate worries; APAC stocks rose afterwards. Brent rose about 2% toward $96.6 on Gulf supply incidents ahead of the 29 Nov OPEC+ meeting. Gold is near a 15-month low around $3,570-3,600, and BTC is around $60.6-60.9k with continued ETF outflows. Items marked T00:00Z are dated by day only.
